briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 push AGI timelines as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with frontier labs releasing advanced models weekly. Compute scaling continues unabated while regulatory frameworks lag. Multi-agent security remains the critical bottleneck for deployment.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4 with 2T parameters this week. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus and xAI deployed Grok-3 on custom cluster. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta Llama-4 follow closely.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize agent isolation.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce 50k H100-equivalent clusters. TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production ramp. Energy constraints slow European builds.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge determine which labs achieve safe AGI deployment first?
